content.string: The meeting is called to order at 4:00 PM; it being noted that the following Members were in remote attendance: M. van Holst, M. Salih, J. Helmer, M. Cassidy, S. Lehman, A. Hopkins, P. Van Meerbergen, E. Peloza, A. Kayabaga and S. Hillier.
That it BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

motion_texts.string: That, pursuant to section 27.6 of the Council Procedure By-law, the order of business be changed to allow for consideration of item 4.2 at this time.

1.title: 2020 Performance Report and May 2021 Semi-Annual Progress Report

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the City Manager, the staff report dated July 28, 2021 including the 2020 Performance Report, May 2021 Semi-Annual Progress Report BE RECEIVED for information.

2.title: Municipal Accommodation Tax - Required Annual Report

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the Deputy City Manager, Planning and Economic Development, Tourism’s London annual report on the expenditure of Municipal Accommodation Tax revenues BE RECEIVED for information.

3.title: Diversity Inclusion and Anti-Oppression Advisory Committee

1.title: Request for Delegation Status - Roula Hawa, Mischa Mackie (Schlemmer) and Reeti Chopra - Housing and Homelessness Crisis

motion_texts.string: The following actions be taken with respect to the delegation from Roula Hawa, Mischa Mackie (Schlemmer) and Reeti Chopra related to the Housing and Homelessness Crisis in London:
a)   the above-noted presentation BE RECEIVED: and,

b)   the recommendations forming part of the presentation BE FORWARDED to the Civic Administration, for consideration and potential implementation, including but not limited to participation in the knowledge-exchange activities related to this report.
That the requested delegation status for Roula Hawa, Mischa Mackie (Schlemmer) and Reeti Chopra BE APPROVED to be heard at this time.

attachments.title: 2021-07-28 Submission - Recommendations Brescia and Gender-Based Violence Project 2021

2.title: Consideration of Appointment to the London & Middlesex Community Housing Board (Requires 1 Council Member)

motion_texts.string: That Councillor J. Morgan BE APPOINTED to the London & Middlesex Community Housing Board for the term ending November 15, 2022.
Appointment of a Council Member to the London and Middlesex Community Housing Board
That the communication dated July 26, 2021 from Councillor M. van Holst BE RECEIVED and no further action BE TAKEN.

2.title: (ADDED) Regional Transportation and Mobility Across Southwestern Ontario

motion_texts.string:
That, the following actions be taken with respect to the communication dated July 27, 2021 from Mayor E. Holder and Deputy Mayor J. Morgan regarding the Regional Transportation and Mobility across Southwestern Ontario :



a)    the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to develop a conceptual framework for a Regional Transportation/Mobility Hub in downtown London, including working with London Transit to explore potential connections between a regional transportation/mobility hub and local City of London transit routes, including the proposed bus rapid transit system, for Council’s consideration; and,



b)   the Mayor BE REQUESTED to engage with the Southwest Ontario Transportation Task Force membership on the opportunity of positioning the City of London as a Regional Transportation/Mobility Hub for consideration by the Province of Ontario under the Connecting the Southwest: A Draft Transportation Plan for Southwestern Ontario.
